description: Reads one contact's history: the contact (id, kind, name, stage and why it may not be contacted, if so; for someone who signed up with the business, person, as crm_search gives it, and their address only when the owner is the one asking) and every touch with them, oldest first, each with its time, direction (out from the business, or in), channel, kind (pitch, email, reply, dm, comment, order, sign-up, unsubscribe, quote, placement, bounce, complaint, deal), summary and the work id it belonged to. Use it after crm_search to answer what happened with someone; an unknown id is refused.

contactId.description: The contact's id, as crm_search gives it.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: crm_timeline
title: Crm timeline
